decisions.rationale: Talonflame's priority Tailwind targets our side, bypassing Armor Tail. Kingambit Kowtow Cleave (85.5-160%) into Farigiraf moves before Trick Room, threatening to deny it entirely. Kingambit is also immune to Liepard's Prankster status. In back, Mega Gardevoir provides late-game Pixilate Hyper Voice spread pressure, and Samurott-H's Aqua Cutter OHKOs Mega Camerupt (156-284%, 4x effective) — the most dangerous TR sweeper. Dragapult is benched because Shadow Ball is immune into Farigiraf.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has dual-Mega options (Camerupt + Mawile) with Trick Room mode via Farigiraf. Armor Tail blocks all priority moves targeting their side but not self-targeting/field moves like Tailwind. Farigiraf holds Mental Herb. Kingambit is the primary Farigiraf answer; Samurott-H is the Camerupt answer. Liepard's Fake Out (+3) outruns Gale Wings (+1) — be ready for the 50/50 on turn 1. Mega Mawile is handled best by Incineroar (Intimidate + Flare Blitz) if it comes in game 2/3. Palafin is threatening with Jet Punch but Gardevoir can pressure it.

decisions.rationale: Lead the protected Trick Room mode: Armor Tail stops Fake Out and other priority into Farigiraf, while Mental Herb covers Taunt. Mega Camerupt pressures Incineroar and Kingambit strongly under Room. Mawile gives a second slow Fairy/Steel endgame, and Palafin offers Fire/Ground-resistant pivot pressure.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 preview plan: Farigiraf + Camerupt is primary Trick Room lead into Incineroar/Kingambit structures; Armor Tail blocks their priority disruption and Mental Herb preserves Trick Room through Taunt. Bring Mawile as slow Mega-capable Steel/Fairy endgame and Palafin for Fire/Ground-resistant pivot pressure. Opponent has Talonflame Tailwind/Taunt, Dragapult LO special offense, Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice, and Samurott-H Sharpness physical pressure.

decisions.rationale: Armor Tail blocks priority attacks on foes (Brave Bird, Sucker Punch); Mental Herb blocks Taunt on Farigiraf. Switch Talonflame to Samurott-H, which resists Fire and OHKOs Mega Camerupt with Aqua Cutter. Kingambit Kowtow Cleave threatens 85.5-160% on Farigiraf — if it OHKOs, Trick Room is prevented. If not, Samurott-H is positioned to handle Camerupt under TR.

decisions.rationale: Samurott Aqua Cutter is a guaranteed OHKO on Camerupt-Mega (142-317%) and Samurott outspeeds. Talonflame enters at full HP with Gale Wings active (Armor Tail is gone), enabling priority Tailwind to secure speed control for the rest of the game. Even if Camerupt Protects, Tailwind goes up safely; if it stays in, it faints and we lead 3v2 with Tailwind.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Camerupt)
decisions.rationale: Mental Herb ensures Trick Room through Talonflame Taunt, while Armor Tail blocks Kingambit Sucker Punch. Mega Camerupt keeps full-HP Eruption pressure this turn and becomes an excellent Trick Room attacker afterward; it can heavily damage or potentially remove Kingambit while also chipping Talonflame.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 plan confirmed: Farigiraf Mental Herb + Armor Tail reliably establishes Trick Room versus Talonflame Taunt and blocks priority such as Kingambit Sucker Punch. Mega Camerupt is the selected Mega this game for immediate full-HP Eruption pressure and very low Speed under Trick Room; Mawile will remain non-Mega. Preserve Farigiraf where possible to maintain priority denial, and use Palafin as a Fire/Ground-resistant pivot/endgame option.

decisions.rationale: Bring Palafin in: it is the safest immediate partner for Mega Camerupt against Samurott-Hisui’s Water pressure and preserves Mawile for a potentially stronger late-game physical endgame.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Mega Camerupt was selected and is already Mega Evolved. Farigiraf is unavailable for the rest of this game. Opponent revealed Talonflame, Kingambit, and Samurott-Hisui; their fourth is exactly one of Incineroar, Dragapult, or Gardevoir. Talonflame carries Tailwind/Taunt/Will-O-Wisp/Brave Bird with Sharp Beak and Gale Wings. Samurott-Hisui has Sharpness, Chople Berry, and Ceaseless Edge/Aqua Cutter/Sacred Sword/Protect. Kingambit had Black Glasses Defiant. Preserve Mega Camerupt where feasible; Palafin can pivot out to activate Zero to Hero. Mawile remains non-Mega because Camerupt used this game’s Mega Evolution.

decisions.rationale: Tailwind (+1 priority via Gale Wings, faster than Palafin's Jet Punch) goes first and doubles our speed. Aqua Cutter OHKOs Camerupt-Mega (4x SE, 142-317%) before it can Eruption. Talonflame survives Jet Punch (54-86%). After this turn: Tailwind up, Camerupt gone, only Palafin remains, Gardevoir in back ready to clean.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Kingambit fainted turn 1 after KOing Farigiraf. Samurott-H is primary Camerupt answer (Aqua Cutter 4x OHKO). Talonflame Gale Wings secures priority Tailwind at full HP. Opponent has dual-Mega (Camerupt + Mawile) with Trick Room mode; Farigiraf eliminated. Unrevealed foe is one of Mawile/Floette-Eternal/Liepard. Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate Hyper Voice) threatens Palafin. Chople Berry on Samurott-H intact.

decisions.rationale: Preserve Mega Camerupt from the immediate Aqua Cutter threat while pivoting Palafin out to enable Zero to Hero. Mawile gives a sturdier partner through Talonflame’s likely Tailwind turn; Protect also covers a direct Samurott attack into Camerupt.

Preserve Camerupt when feasible; pivot Palafin to activate Zero to Hero. Talonflame and Samurott are both still available.

decisions.rationale: Aqua Cutter OHKOs Camerupt-Mega (4x Sharpness). Will-O-Wisp on Mawile (85%) cripples Huge Power Play Rough from guaranteed OHKO to ~70-105% range on 57% Samurott. Even if Wisp misses and Samurott falls, Gardevoir-Mega + Talonflame cleanly handle burned Mawile + Palafin. Camerupt can't touch Talonflame (Earth Power immune, Fire NVE).
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Kingambit and Farigiraf fainted. Opponent dual-Mega Camerupt+Mawile; Camerupt already Mega. Palafin-Hero unrevealed on bench. My Tailwind active 3 more turns. Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate) in back threatens Palafin. Chople Berry on Samurott-H intact. Sharpness Aqua Cutter is primary Camerupt answer.

decisions.rationale: Switching Camerupt preserves it from the immediate 4x Aqua Cutter threat while bringing in Zero to Hero Palafin. Play Rough is a guaranteed KO on Samurott from its shown 57% if it does not Protect; Mawile survives either Brave Bird or Sacred Sword individually, and removing Samurott is the highest-value outcome.

decisions.rationale: Double into Palafin-Hero: Talonflame Brave Bird (32-70%) + Samurott Ceaseless Edge (29-62%) before Palafin moves under Tailwind. ~35-40% chance to KO Palafin outright, saving Talonflame from the guaranteed Wave Crash OHKO. If Palafin falls, we have Talonflame + Gardevoir vs Mawile (brn) + Camerupt with 2 turns of Tailwind left—clearly winnable. If Palafin lives, both actives fall but that outcome is near-unavoidable anyway; this line at least creates a real path to victory.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Kingambit and Farigiraf fainted. Opponent dual-Mega Camerupt+Mawile; Camerupt already Mega so Mawile locked out of Mega. Tailwind has 2 turns left. Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate) is my win condition—needs Steel removed or weakened. Chople Berry on Samurott-H intact, Burn on Mawile valuable. Palafin-Hero is the immediate threat with Wave Crash OHKOing Talonflame. Ceaseless Edge sets Spikes on connect.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Play Rough guarantees the KO on the weakened Samurott despite burn. Palafin survives Talonflame Brave Bird plus Samurott’s Water pressure, and unburned Mystic Water Wave Crash cleanly removes Talonflame; Talonflame has no Protect revealed.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Mega Gardevoir Mystical Fire into Mawile has ~80% chance to OHKO (67.5-172.8% vs 88% HP). Talonflame Brave Bird chips Camerupt-Mega (37-82%). If Mawile faints, it's 2v1; Gardevoir survives Eruption (36-63%) and cleans up next turn. If Mawile lives, it's crippled and burned. Sucker Punch only does 10-19% pre-Mystical Fire. This aggressive line maximizes win probability over the safer Protect+Tailwind refresh.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Kingambit and Samurott-Hisui fainted. Gardevoir Mega Evolved turn 5. Opponent dual-Mega Camerupt+Mawile; Camerupt already Mega so Mawile locked out. Burn on Mawile from turn 3 critical. Tailwind expires end of turn 5. Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate) is win condition but both foes resist Fairy; need to remove Steel (Mawile) first, then Fire (Camerupt) second. Spikes on opponent's side from Ceaseless Edge.

decisions.rationale: Protect preserves burned Mawile from Mega Gardevoir’s likely Mystical Fire while full-power Eruption pressures both foes before Tailwind expires. It also covers an attacking Gardevoir better than risking Mawile for an uncertain Iron Head KO.

reflections.summary: We won by eliminating Farigiraf on turn 1 to deny Trick Room, then leveraging Tailwind speed control and a burn on Mawile to outpace and weaken their remaining threats, with Gardevoir-Mega cleaning up.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, bring Liepard over Samurott to Fake Out or Taunt the Trick Room setter, and be prepared for a potential Mawile-Mega or Liepard from the opponent.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's game 1 plan: lead Farigiraf + Camerupt-Mega for Trick Room + Eruption. They Mega Evolved Camerupt, not Mawile. Palafin-Hero is their physical water attacker. They did not bring Liepard or Floette-Eternal. Expect adaptation: they may Mega Evolve Mawile to avoid burn and hit harder under Trick Room, or bring Liepard for disruption. Our Tailwind + Gardevoir-Mega was effective. Future plan: consider Liepard for Fake Out/Taunt to counter Trick Room; keep Gardevoir-Mega as special offense. Kingambit can snipe Farigiraf but is fire-weak; preserve it or replace with Liepard if they protect Farigiraf better.

reflections.summary: Lost because Farigiraf was removed before Trick Room, letting Talonflame Tailwind control speed; the Camerupt-Mega/Mawile pairing then lacked a stable answer to Talonflame plus Mega Gardevoir, with un-Mega Mawile burned and cleaned by Mystical Fire.
reflections.adjustment: Reconsider the preview Mega choice: bring the same slow-mode core if needed, but Mega Evolve Mawile rather than Camerupt and preserve it for the Gardevoir endgame; do not rely on Farigiraf surviving a Kingambit Kowtow to establish Trick Room.
reflections.notebook: Opponent favors Talonflame Tailwind support and Will-O-Wisp pressure alongside fast Mega Gardevoir; Talonflame showed Sharp Beak Gale Wings with Taunt/Brave Bird. Kingambit can immediately KO Farigiraf with Black Glasses Kowtow Cleave. Hisuian Samurott uses Ceaseless Edge to establish Spikes and carries Chople Berry. Mega Gardevoir carries Mystical Fire, so retain a sturdier Mega Mawile option rather than automatically Mega Evolving Camerupt.
